400名工人参与了停工。

en: an object that fits into the top of a bottle to close it
ex: He pulled out the stopper and took a long drink of water.
他拉出塞子，喝了一杯水。

en: a train that stops at a lot of stations between main stations

zh: （赛跑等计时用的）秒表，跑表，码表
en: a watch that you can stop and start by pressing buttons, in order to time a race, etc. accurately, or an app on a phone that can perform the same function
the process of keeping something in a particular place until it is needed; the space where things can be kept
ex: tables that fold flat for storage
便于存放的折叠桌

en: a large battery that you can fill with electrical power (= that you can recharge)
an electric heater that stores heat when electricity is cheaper, for example at night

zh: （某类或作某用途的）商品，物品
en: a large shop that sells many different types of goods
ex: It's available at London's three biggest stores.
它可以在伦敦的三大商店买到。

en: a card that a particular shop provides for regular customers so that they can use it to buy goods that they will pay for later

zh: 商店专抓行窃者的雇员
en: a person employed by a large shop to watch customers and make sure they do not steal goods
ex: The store detective was keeping a close eye on a suspected shoplifter.
商店的保安正严密监视一个可疑的商店扒手。

zh: （把强烈的感情或问题）郁积，憋在心里
en: to not deal with problems when you have them, especially when this causes problems later
ex: By ignoring your feelings you are only storing up trouble for yourself.
你回避自己的感受，将来会有麻烦的。

en: the glass at the front of a shop and the area behind it where goods are shown to the public
